title: Weekly stock template
intro: Set how much of each product you usually bring on a weekday, and at what price. This refills automatically for customers browsing that weekday — no extra step needed.

table.caption: Weekly stock template, one row per product and one column per weekday

template.note: Leave a day's quantity blank to skip it. A blank price keeps the product's current price.

empty.title: Add a product first
empty.text: A weekly template needs at least one product.
